releaseNotes: The platform execution boundary now reports founder approvals: core/adapters/platform-execution.ts joins the compiled plan's approval requirements with the durable run's decision record (id, description, workflow, status, effective protected category). Only the durable run is consulted — an approval that exists only on a throwaway seeded run has nothing an answer could be recorded against, so it is never advertised as answerable.

Formation mirrors each parked approval into its decision system and answers travel back exclusively through core/session/approve.ts, the engine's one sanctioned path out of waiting_founder. The platform never writes run state, control, grants, or waivers; a mirrored decision closes only after the engine confirms it recorded the answer, and editing the mirror into "decided" is refused.

Honesty at the gate boundary: an unreachable engine is reported as unreachable — never as "no approvals waiting" — and it can neither create, close, nor supersede a mirrored decision. Silence is never consent: an unanswered approval stays open with no timeout, and no autonomy setting or platform operating mode answers on the founder's behalf.
